name: High Cable Triceps Extension — Kneeling Drop Set
description: A triceps overhead cable extension performed from the kneeling position facing away from a high pulley, executed as a drop set where the weight is immediately reduced after reaching failure and the exerciser continues the set. The kneeling position provides a stable base, the high cable angle stretches the long head of the triceps maximally, and the drop set structure maximizes time-under-tension and metabolic stress for triceps hypertrophy.

execution.starting_position: Kneel on the floor facing away from a high cable pulley. Hold a rope attachment behind the head with both hands, elbows pointing upward and slightly forward.
execution.setup_instructions: Set up two weight settings in advance for the drop: a heavier starting weight and a lighter follow-up. Some machines allow quick pin changes; otherwise have a training partner help reduce the weight.
steps: Step 1: Begin kneeling with the rope held behind the head. Extend the elbows to full lockout, pressing the rope forward and downward.
Step 2: Squeeze the triceps at full extension, then slowly return to the bent-elbow start.
Step 3: Continue until failure at the starting weight.
Step 4: Immediately reduce the weight (drop) and continue the set for additional reps to secondary failure.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the extension (press). Inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Flaring the elbows wide — keep them in line with the head, not splayed out
Moving the upper arm during the extension — only the forearms should move
Allowing the torso to lean excessively forward to assist the press
safety_considerations: Ensure quick weight reduction is possible before beginning — plan the drop logistics first
Avoid excessive neck strain — the rope attachment should not press on the neck
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full elbow extension at the bottom. Full elbow flexion (rope behind head) at the top.
execution.tempo_recommendations: 2s extension, 1s lockout, 3s eccentric return. Full ROM on each rep of both the initial and drop set.
coaching_cues: Keep the elbows tight — do not let them flare during the press
Squeeze the triceps at lockout — the constant tension from the high cable makes this very effective
The drop set should be a smooth transition — have the lighter weight ready to go immediately
